video_title: Steph Curry's New Shoe Deal Is a Global Power Move

quotes.speaker: Joe Shasky
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's new shoe deal and the broader sneaker culture
quotes.excerpt: I'm not a big shoe guy. I will raise my hand up and say, there's a big shoe culture.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Shasky
text_blocks.text: So you saw that drop on Steph signing with this different company. What did you think?

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Spadoni
text_blocks.text: First off, I said I don't know what that company is. But I'm also not a big shoe guy. I will raise my hand up and say, there's a big shoe culture that I have just never gravitated towards.

quotes.speaker: Joe Shasky
quotes.summary_phrase: The disconnect between older fans and modern youth sneaker trends
quotes.excerpt: They buy what their parents buy for them. The kids' shoes that I see in the gym.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Shasky
text_blocks.text: I'm not a high school basketball player. I'm 43 years old. But you coach a lot of kids that are around that age. They buy what their parents buy for them. The kids' shoes that I see in the gym are Lamelos, the two-color shoe Lamelos. I see Yiannis, I see a lot of Jaws, and then I see a ton of throwback Kobes. That is all the rage right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Spadoni
text_blocks.text: I have Yiannises actually. Apparently, Dwyane Wade was also signed to this shoe and it was very popular once upon a time there.

quotes.speaker: Joe Spadoni
quotes.summary_phrase: Why Warriors fans were hoping for a major brand shoe deal
quotes.excerpt: Most Curry fans in the stands were hoping it was either Adidas or Nike.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Spadoni
text_blocks.text: I'm going to be honest, I think most Curry fans in the stands were hoping it was either Adidas or Nike because they were very underwhelmed when he was with Under Armour.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Shasky
text_blocks.text: People know, I'm just saying, when my wife has her family, I'm just going off my wife's family, the Curry brand is actually huge. All the uncles wear it and they got the sweatshirts and the three things. There is a huge niche of people when I go to the store, I do see a lot of OGs, older guys, older than me, older than me to be like the Grant status. They are in the old school Currys.

quotes.speaker: Joe Spadoni
quotes.summary_phrase: The four most iconic individual basketball brands of the last 25 years
quotes.excerpt: It was Michael Jordan, it was Kobe Bryant, LeBron James, Steph Curry.
quotes.quote: In the last decade alone, it was Michael Jordan, it was Kobe Bryant, LeBron James, Steph Curry. Greece was obviously Yiannis, because that was the Greek freak. But those are the four I saw everywhere. And then obviously you got your Messis and Ronaldos on top of that. Those are the four biggest individual brands in the last 25 years in basketball, it has to be.

quotes.speaker: Joe Shasky
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan brand's unmatched dominance across all professional sports
quotes.excerpt: The Jordan brand is the only one that's crossed over to every sport.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Shasky
text_blocks.text: If I were to ask you the NFL, what's the biggest brand in the NFL? That's not a team. It's the Jordan shoes. There's no other accessory that you can think of. It's the Jordan cleats.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Spadoni
text_blocks.text: Baseball, almost the same thing. It's that big in baseball too, the Jordan brand, because you're more tapped into it than I am.
